run_2035_ref_v4.executive_line: Link 20014 (ART, 2 lanes) carries 136% of its capacity in the AM peak, well beyond what the road can serve.
run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: V/C 1.36 on ART link 20014 (1007→1006) in AM, user_class ALL: volume 7344 over AM (2448 veh/h) against capacity 1800 veh/h. Peer group ART x CBD x AM median V/C 0.71. Congested speed 52.9 km/h against free-flow 80 km/h.

evidence.query:
SELECT f.link_id, f.volume, f.vc_ratio, l.capacity_vph, l.lanes
FROM link_flows f JOIN links l USING (run_id, link_id)
WHERE f.run_id = 'run_2035_ref_v4' AND f.period = 'AM' AND f.user_class = 'ALL'
  AND f.link_id = '20014'

run_2035_ref_v4.likely_cause: Capacity coded below the observed cross-section, or a parallel route missing from the network so demand funnels onto this link.
run_2035_ref_v4.suggested_action: Verify lanes and capacity_vph against the aerial imagery and the 2035 committed scheme list; check that the parallel corridor is coded and connected.

measures.title: Recode capacity to 4 lanes
measures.description: Set lanes = 4 and capacity_vph = 8000 on link 20014 to match the committed widening scheme (ITC scheme register #214).
measures.estimated_effect: V/C falls from 1.36 to about 1.02 in AM; downstream link 20016 gains around 900 veh over the period.

measures.title: Queue a STEAM rerun with the parallel arterial connected
measures.description: Node 1023 to 1024 arterial is coded one-way; a rerun with two-way coding will confirm whether demand reroutes.

measures.description: The 2035 reference assumes ramp metering on this freeway section; confirm the capacity uplift in the parameter register.
measures.estimated_effect: V/C about 1.08 if the uplift is applied.

run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: V/C 1.042 on FWY link 20051 (1027→1028) in PM, user_class ALL: volume 24998 over PM (8333 veh/h) against capacity 8000 veh/h. Peer group FWY x CBD x PM median V/C 0.71. Congested speed 102 km/h against free-flow 120 km/h.

run_2035_ref_v4.executive_line: The PM highway assignment stopped before it settled, so PM link flows carry more noise than the other periods.
run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: Relative gap at the final iteration (40) for PM is 0.0012 against a target of 0.001. AM, MD, EV and NT met the target. 92.4% of links have GEH < 1 between iterations 38 and 40 (target 95%). Noise band widened to +/- 6% for PM link comparisons.

evidence.query:
SELECT period, iteration, value AS rel_gap
FROM convergence
WHERE run_id = 'run_2035_ref_v4' AND metric = 'rel_gap' AND stage = 'highway'
QUALIFY iteration = MAX(iteration) OVER (PARTITION BY period)

run_2035_ref_v4.likely_cause: Iteration cap of 40 reached before the gap target; PM demand is 8% higher than in the base run so more iterations are needed.
run_2035_ref_v4.suggested_action: Raise the PM iteration cap to 60 or tighten the step size; rerun PM only.

measures.title: Rerun PM with 60 iterations
measures.description: Assignment-only rerun; roughly 25 minutes on the modelling server.
measures.estimated_effect: Relative gap expected below 0.001; PM noise band narrows to +/- 3%.

run_2035_ref_v4.executive_line: One collector road is modelled as faster than its own speed limit in the AM peak, which points to a coding error rather than real traffic.
run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: Congested speed 44.8 km/h exceeds free-flow speed 40 km/h by 12% (limit 5%). Volume-delay function VDF 7 applied where VDF 3 is used on all other COL links.

evidence.query:
SELECT f.link_id, f.cong_speed_kph, l.ffs_kph, f.cong_speed_kph / l.ffs_kph AS ratio
FROM link_flows f JOIN links l USING (run_id, link_id)
WHERE f.run_id = 'run_2035_ref_v4' AND f.period = 'AM' AND f.user_class = 'ALL'
  AND f.cong_speed_kph > 1.05 * l.ffs_kph

run_2035_ref_v4.likely_cause: Wrong volume-delay function assigned to the link.
run_2035_ref_v4.suggested_action: Set VDF 3 on link 20166 and rerun AM.

run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: V/C 0.893 on COL link 20103 (1056→1057) in PM, user_class ALL: volume 3750 over PM (1250 veh/h) against capacity 1400 veh/h. Peer group COL x URBAN x PM median V/C 0.71. Congested speed 54.8 km/h against free-flow 60 km/h.

run_2035_ref_v4.executive_line: Link 20122 carries almost no traffic although the roads around it are busy, which suggests it is disconnected or mis-coded.
run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: V/C 0.02 on ART link 20122 (1041→1031) in AM, user_class ALL: volume 162 over AM (54 veh/h) against capacity 2700 veh/h. Peer group ART x SUBURBAN x AM median V/C 0.71. Congested speed 80 km/h against free-flow 80 km/h.

evidence.query:

FROM link_flows f JOIN links l USING (run_id, link_id)

  AND f.link_id = '20122'

run_2035_ref_v4.likely_cause: Turn prohibition or missing connector at node 1041 leaves the link unreachable.
run_2035_ref_v4.suggested_action: Inspect turn penalties at the A node and confirm the link direction.

run_2035_ref_v4.executive_line: Zone 412 loads its traffic straight onto the freeway, which is not how people would actually reach the road network.
run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: Centroid connector from zone 412 attaches at node 1027, which is a node of FWY link 20045. Connectors must attach to ART, COL or LOC links (high_class_links = FWY, EXP).

evidence.query:
SELECT c.link_id, c.a_node, l.link_class
FROM links c JOIN nodes n ON n.node_id = c.a_node AND n.is_centroid
JOIN links l ON l.a_node = c.b_node OR l.b_node = c.b_node
WHERE c.run_id = 'run_2035_ref_v4' AND l.link_class IN ('FWY','EXP')

run_2035_ref_v4.likely_cause: Connector snapped to the nearest node during network editing.
run_2035_ref_v4.suggested_action: Move the connector end to node 1017 on the parallel arterial.

run_2035_ref_v4.executive_line: Sector 3 has 6.4% more jobs than the agreed 2035 planning total, so its traffic will be overstated.
run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: Sum of employment over zones in sector S3 = 212,400 against control total 199,600 (diff share 0.064, tolerance 0.02). Population within tolerance (diff share 0.007).

evidence.query:
SELECT z.sector_id, lu.variable, SUM(lu.value) AS zone_sum, MAX(lu.control_total) AS control_total
FROM land_use lu JOIN zones z USING (run_id, zone_id)
WHERE lu.run_id = 'run_2035_ref_v4'
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING ABS(zone_sum / control_total - 1) > 0.02

run_2035_ref_v4.likely_cause: The 2035 employment file predates the revised Reem Island phasing.
run_2035_ref_v4.suggested_action: Replace land_use_2035.csv rows for sector S3 with the revised phasing (DMT letter 2026-07-14) and rerun demand.

measures.title: Scale sector S3 employment to the control total
measures.description: Apply a uniform factor 0.94 to employment in sector S3 zones.
measures.estimated_effect: About 4,100 fewer AM trips attracted to S3; V/C on the Reem bridge links falls by 0.05.

run_2035_ref_v4.executive_line: Bus route 56 is coded with a 150 minute gap between buses, far above anything the operator runs.
run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: headway_p1 (AM) = 150 min for line B056, mode BUS. Allowed range 2 to 120 min; mode maximum for BUS is 120 min.

evidence.query:
SELECT line_id, mode, headway_p1
FROM transit_lines
WHERE run_id = 'run_2035_ref_v4' AND (headway_p1 < 2 OR headway_p1 > 120)

run_2035_ref_v4.likely_cause: Headway typed in seconds-per-two-buses or a placeholder left in the line file.
run_2035_ref_v4.suggested_action: Confirm the AM headway with the ITC bus service plan (likely 15 min) and correct the .lin file.

run_2035_ref_v4.executive_line: Bus route 112 runs almost empty although it passes through busy areas.
run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: Load factor 0.038 (AM) for line B112 against a minimum of 0.05; catchment demand within 1 km = 3,900 trips. Change vs base run is inside the noise band (+/- 0.01).

evidence.query:
SELECT line_id, SUM(load) / SUM(vehicle_capacity * 60.0 / headway_p1) AS load_factor
FROM line_loads JOIN transit_lines USING (run_id, line_id)
WHERE run_id = 'run_2035_ref_v4' AND period = 'AM'
GROUP BY line_id HAVING load_factor < 0.05

run_2035_ref_v4.likely_cause: Also below threshold in the base run; a known low-demand service.
run_2035_ref_v4.suggested_action: No action for this run; review in the service plan.

run_2035_ref_v4.executive_line: A small number of network nodes are missing a junction type, which affects how delays are computed at those points.
run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: 14 of 3,812 node rows (0.37%) have NULL junction_control. No missing node or zone references.

evidence.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE junction_control IS NULL) AS null_rows, COUNT(*) AS rows
FROM nodes WHERE run_id = 'run_2035_ref_v4'

run_2035_ref_v4.likely_cause: Nodes added for the 2035 schemes were not given a junction type.
run_2035_ref_v4.suggested_action: Fill junction_control for the 14 nodes listed in the modeller view.

run_2035_ref_v4.executive_line: The AM car commuting matrix contains many tiny fractional values, a harmless side effect of the way trips are split between modes.
run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: 61% of non-zero cells in DEMAND HBW CAR AM are below 0.01 trips. No negative cells; intrazonal share 0.07.

evidence.query:
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN trips < 0.01 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share_small
FROM od WHERE run_id = 'run_2035_ref_v4' AND matrix_kind = 'DEMAND' AND purpose = 'HBW' AND mode = 'CAR' AND period = 'AM'

run_2035_ref_v4.likely_cause: Mode choice applied to a full matrix without a floor.
run_2035_ref_v4.suggested_action: None needed; consider rounding below 0.001 at export to reduce file size.

run_2035_ref_v4.executive_line: Midday public transport trips are about 4% longer than in the base run, a change too small to matter.
run_2035_ref_v4.modeller_view: Mean trip length 9.8 km vs 9.4 km in run_2035_ref_v3 (diff share 0.043; medium threshold 0.15). Within the noise band estimated from base-vs-base reruns (+/- 5%).

evidence.query:
SELECT SUM(o.trips * s.value) / SUM(o.trips) AS mean_km
FROM od o JOIN skims s ON s.skim_kind = 'DIST' AND s.mode = o.mode AND s.period = o.period
  AND s.origin = o.origin AND s.destination = o.destination
WHERE o.run_id = 'run_2035_ref_v4' AND o.purpose = 'HBO' AND o.mode = 'PT' AND o.period = 'MD'

run_2035_ref_v4.likely_cause: Longer bus route 56 after the Saadiyat extension.
